tools.name: check_fact
tools.description: Avoid a duplicate expensive read-only tool call before repeating source-backed validation, especially across an agent fleet. Use for repeated paid web search, metered scraping, browser/extraction, rate-limited APIs, duplicate API validation or multi-step validation when the caller already has a know

tools.name: observe_fact
tools.description: After independently performing a fresh paid search, scrape, browser extraction, API read or other source-backed validation, deposit the observed result for later CHECKs. Returns accepted=true when a new observation is stored or deduplicated=true for a recognized retry/recent duplicate. Never OBSERVE
